source.source_boundary: Manual pp465-466 define RedundancyLink rows as a set of item types in series, with QTYPL times NRL for each type no more than that type's installed QTYPM. Manual p255 requires the summed subitem FRT not to exceed mother FRT. The child has two installed copies of each series item, one of each per link, and System.FRT equals all four installed direct items' ordinary FRT.

Preserve ACTIVE NRL2/NRLRQ1/TSWOV0, original LRU/SRU chain, missions, seed1, rep1 and horizon36.
